meta.licenseNote: Qwen-Image-Layered is Apache-2.0 (Alibaba Qwen, 2025-12); the ComfyUI repack Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-Layered_ComfyUI is Apache-2.0. The app ships no weights.
meta.notes: ComfyUI's official 'Image to Layers (Qwen-Image-Layered)' subgraph (image_qwen_image_layered.json, 2026-10): the picture, VAE-encoded with the layered VAE, enters both conditionings as a ReferenceLatent; EmptyQwenImageLayeredLatentImage makes a latent with `layers` slices at the request's size (multiples of 16; the official graph scales the input to 640 px on its longer side, which the engine does too); ModelSamplingAuraFlow shift 1; KSampler euler/simple 20 steps CFG 2.5; LatentCut drops slice 0 (the whole picture) and LatentCutToBatch turns the remaining slices into a batch, so VAEDecode (RGBA with this VAE) and SaveImage give one PNG per layer, background first. Needs the 19 GB fp8 repack qwen_image_layered_fp8mixed.safetensors and qwen_image_layered_vae.safetensors (https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-Layered_ComfyUI) plus the Qwen2.5-VL 7B text encoder the 2511 templates use.
